name: Hashabiah
bio: Hashabiah, a Levite of the sons of Merari, was brought to Ezra at Casiphia along with Jeshaiah and their relatives, twenty in all, to serve as a minister for the house of God since no Levites had joined the returning exiles. Ezra entrusted him, along with Sherebiah and ten others, with guarding the temple's silver, gold, and vessels on the journey to Jerusalem (Ezra 8:15-19, 24).
